title: RHEM - Runtime Hard-Example Mining for Agent Systems
description: RHEM is a runtime hard-example mining reference implementation for Agent systems. Version 0.6.0 adds an opt-in damping suppressor for dead-zone handling, A-B-A oscillation detection, regret-rate alerts, cooldown and thaw governance, and optional rule downweighting. Damping changes only the timing of automatic evolution actions and remains patch-governed and rollback-capable. This release does not claim production performance, statistical optimality, or proven generalization gains.
notes: RHEM v0.6.0 is a repository release for opt-in damping suppression. Its independent Zenodo version DOI has not yet been generated; use the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22681163 when citing this version before archival. Previous version DOIs remain available: v0.5.1 is 10.5281/zenodo.22719758, v0.5.0 is 10.5281/zenodo.22719697, and v0.4.0 is 10.5281/zenodo.22719563.
